description_en: Generates product detail page materials automatically based on a multimodal large language model (MLLM) and structured image-text extraction to help e-commerce platforms and brands supplement product detail pages. After the caller pushes product information such as the product ID, title, brand, main image, and shop name, the service automatically locates identical products, performs consistency checks, extracts size information and product attributes, renders them into SVG size and attribute charts for direct use on the detail page, and returns structured detail copy classifications and processing remarks
description_zh: 基于多模态大模型（MLLM）+ 图文结构化抽取构建的商品详情素材自动生成产品，面向电商平台 / 品牌商的商品详情页素材补齐场景。调用方推送待查询商品信息（商品 ID、标题、品牌、主图、店铺名），产品自动定位其同款商品并做一致性校验，再从同款商品详情中抽取尺码信息与商品属性，渲染为可直接用于详情页的尺码图与属性图（SVG），同时返回结构化的详情文案分类与处理备注
